notes: SHELLQs quasar; one of the first two z>6 quasar hosts with detected starlight (JWST/NIRCam 2D decomposition; host stellar mass ~1.3e11 Msun). Added by batch S (quasar expansion from Ren et al. 2024 intro citations). Coordinates derived from the HSC IAU designation J223644.58+003256.9; SIMBAD refinement pending via coords_todo_batchS. Batch T verified against Ding+2023 Extended Data Table 1: RA 22:36:44.58 Dec +00:32:56.90 and z=6.40 match exactly (NIRSpec [OIII] systemic z=6.4039+-0.0009); host detected in both F356W and F150W.
